reason: I re-ran the analysis and the null result holds. The raw positive association (about 1.6) is confounded by firm size and prior patenting. With those controls, or with all pre-period controls, the estimate stays at about -0.2 to -0.3 (p of about 0.24 to 0.40), with a tight CI against an outcome SD of about 11. Subgroup differences and a quadratic term don't change this.
